evidence_type: systematic review with narrative synthesis, abstract-only
original_summary: ADHD-related symptoms were consistent correlates of functional difficulty. Performance tests and everyday reports capture different aspects of executive function; TS-only groups were not uniformly free of selective difficulties. Heterogeneity prevented a pooled effect.
limitations: Secondary synthesis, not 30 new independent studies or proof comorbidity causes impairment. Preregistration, risk-of-bias judgments and cohort overlap not independently audited.
funding_conflicts: Abstract metadata reports Italian Ministry of Health Current Research funding for one author.
